name: Limonene
summary: A citrus-scented monoterpene profile declared in WYLD pack language.
evidence: Declared in the botanical terpene blend of 2 flavors (Kiwi, Prickly Pear). No published Wyld batch certificate quantifies it: the NY terpene panels return traces of other terpenes only, and the Arizona certificates mark terpenes Not Tested.

pubchem.title: 1-Methyl-4-Prop-1-En-2-Ylcyclohexene
pubchem.description: Limonene is a monoterpene that is cyclohex-1-ene substituted by a methyl group at position 1 and a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 4 respectively. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a cycloalkene and a p-menthadiene.

studies.title: Behavioral Pharmacology of Orally Administered THC and D-limonene
studies.summary: The current clinical trial will investigate the effects of orally administered d-limonene (limonene), delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and the combination in healthy adult volunteers.

studies.title: CYP2C19 Variants and Limonene Metabolism
studies.summary: The investigators will examine whether a non-invasive screening tool for CYP2C19 genetic variants can be developed by measuring limonene metabolism.

studies.title: d-Limonene +Radiation +PlatinumBasedChemo for Xerostomia Prevention in LocallyAdvanced HNSCC
studies.summary: This study explores the safety of d-limonene, a commercially-available dietary supplement (food) as a potential therapeutic for the severe dry mouth (xerostomia) experienced by patients with head and neck cancer as a side effect of their anti-cancer treatment.

studies.title: New Non-invasive Biomarkers of Metabolic Dysfunction-associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD)
interventions: Fish Oil Concentrate, 1000 Mg Oral Capsule
studies.summary:
The goal of this observational study is to learn if some components of blood or exhaled breath can diagnose people having more fat in their livers than is normal, because of their poorer metabolic health (for example, because of obesity and diabetes). The main questions it aims to answer are:

1. Can a method find participants with higher liver fat than healthy participants?
2. Can a method find participants in whom higher liver fat was a cause of liver inflammation or stiffness?

Participants will:

* fast overnight
* have a routine blood draw
* easily exhale a few times into a special device

studies.title: Limonene on Regulating Metabolism-related Fatty Liver Disease (MAFLD) and Analysis of TCM Constitution
studies.summary: The prevention and treatment of metabolic-related fatty liver disease (MAFLD) involves many fields in preventive medicine and clinical medicine. So far, western medicine has not yet completed the elucidation of the mechanism of this type of disease, and there is a lack of effective therapeutic drugs.The purpose of this study was to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of limonene capsules (marketed product in China) in the treatment of metabolic-related fatty liver disease and related lipid-lowering mechanisms.

studies.title: Limonene Study in Women With Breast Cancer
studies.summary: Limonene is a major component in the essential oils of citrus fruits. It has demonstrated promising breast cancer preventive and therapeutic effects in preclinical model systems. This early phase clinical study will evaluate the distribution of limonene to the breast tissue and its associated biological activities after 2 to 6 weeks of limonene dosing in women with a recent diagnosis of early stage breast cancer. This study will help evaluate the potentials of developing limonene as a breast cancer preventive agent.

studies.title: Human Breast Tissue Bioavailability of Topically Applied Limonene
studies.summary: The overall objective of this project is to determine the safety and breast tissue bioavailability of limonene following massage application of limonene containing massage oil to the breast.

studies.title: Limonene for Pulmonary Nodule Chemoprevention
studies.sponsor: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
studies.summary: The prevention and treatment of lung nodules involves many fields in preventive medicine and clinical medicine. A nodule is a growth or lump that may be malignant (cancer) or benign (not cancer). This study is aim to investigate the chemopreventive effect of limonene in inhibiting the occurrence/progression of ground glass pulmonary nodules. It is expected that limonene can be used as a safe and effective chemopreventive agent for preventing the development/progress of pulmonary nodules as well as expanding the indications of limonene.

consumer_summary.what_it_is: Limonene is a monoterpene, a type of volatile molecule that gives many citrus fruits their bright, zesty aroma. As a common human metabolite and natural flavoring, it is something you likely encounter every day in fruit juices, teas, and aromatic essential oils.
consumer_summary.found_in: It is famously abundant in the peels of citrus fruits like lemon (Citrus limon) and sweet orange (Citrus sinensis), as well as in herbs like fennel (Foeniculum vulgare) and rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis).
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Researchers are drawn to limonene for its broad biological potential, particularly its role in cellular defense and metabolism. With over 6,700 published papers, scientists are exploring how this ubiquitous citrus compound interacts with human tissues. The strongest evidence so far comes from human observational studies and early clinical trials (Oxford level 2b), which are actively investigating its antioxidant properties and its behavior in the body.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Researchers are exploring whether limonene might support cellular health in the context of cancer, investigating how it accumulates in human tissues.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A completed Phase 1 clinical trial (NCT01046929) studied limonene in women with breast cancer; the next step would be a Phase 2 randomized controlled trial to measure its efficacy on tumor biomarkers over several months.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Early animal work points toward limonene having a calming effect, and researchers are curious if it can modulate subjective mood and anxiety in humans.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A recruiting Phase 1 clinical trial (NCT06378957) is currently testing the behavioral pharmacology and subjective effects of orally administered D-limonene alongside THC in 65 participants.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Scientists are investigating whether limonene's interactions with the nervous system might offer a natural pathway for pain relief.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: To advance this from Oxford level 5, researchers would need to design a randomized, placebo-controlled human trial measuring subjective pain scores in healthy adults exposed to a mild, controlled pain stimulus after ingesting limonene.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: If early findings bear out, limonene might play a role in supporting cognitive function and memory.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: The next step would be a human randomized controlled trial assessing cognitive performance metrics, such as memory recall and attention tasks, in adults taking a daily limonene supplement over several weeks.

associated_conditions.relationship: recorded as an occupational exposure hazard in industrial settings

consumer_summary.cautions: In industrial settings, concentrated limonene is an occupational solvent hazard, and oxidized limonene (such as in aged cosmetics or essential oils) is a known trigger for allergic contact dermatitis.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: The best evidence so far comes from human observational work and early clinical trials (Oxford level 2b) exploring its antioxidant and cellular effects, while its neurological and mood benefits currently rest on animal research.
